title: MineHavenSMP
description: A high-performance, engineering-focused NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack/server centered around the Create mod, advanced logistics, automation, immersive world generation, and seamless server performance.
body:
# MineHavenSMP

Welcome to **MineHaven**, the ultimate Minecraft experience that beautifully bridges engineering mastery, immersive exploration, and cozy living. Built on NeoForge for 1.21.1, MineHaven transforms your world into a living, breathing mechanical paradise. 

Whether you want to build massive automated factories, chart uncharted biomes, cook up a storm, or simply settle down in a beautifully detailed cottage, MineHaven has a home for you.

---

## 🛠️ The Heart of Innovation: Mechanical Mastery
At the core of MineHaven is the **Create Mod** and its finest expansions. Automate everything, harness new power sources, and build the infrastructure of your dreams.
* **Create & Create Casing:** Build intricate, visually stunning machinery, custom kinetic networks, and beautiful factory housing.
* **Create: New Age & Addition:** Bridge the gap between kinetic motion and electricity. Generate, store, and utilize energy to power advanced components.
* **Enchantment Industry & Ore Excavation:** Automate your magical progression with fluid enchantments and set up industrial drill sites to keep your resource vaults overflowing.
* **Tom’s Simple Storage & Sophisticated Storage:** Keep your factory clean. Upgrade from basic chests to massive, item-filtering storage networks and deep digital-style warehouses.

## 🌍 A World Reimagined: Generation & Exploration
Adventure waits just outside your factory gates. MineHaven features completely overhauled world generation that makes every expedition unique and rewarding.
* **Terralith & Tectonic:** Feast your eyes on breathtaking, realistic landscapes, soaring mountain ranges, and dynamic terrain that breathes new life into the Overworld.
* **YUNG’s Better Series:** Dive underground or venture into old relics. Strongholds, Mineshafts, Dungeons, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, and Nether Fortresses have been entirely redesigned to be massive, immersive, and filled with loot.
* **Serene Seasons:** Watch the world change around you as seasons dynamically shift, affecting crop growth and weather patterns.
* **Waystones & Nature's Compass:** Never get lost. Navigate to your favorite biomes effortlessly and set up quick-travel networks between your outposts.

## 🍲 Cozy Living & Vibrant Wildlife
If industrial factories aren't your only passion, MineHaven offers a deep, relaxing sandbox for farming, cooking, and interacting with nature.
* **Farmer’s Delight & Expansions:** Grow new crops, cook gourmet meals in a fully functional kitchen system (complete with *Slice & Dice* automation), and enjoy the culinary arts.
* **Naturalist & Critters and Companions:** The world is teeming with life! Encounter realistic animals, birds, and aquatic critters that bring the forests and oceans to life.
* **Comforts:** Take your adventures on the go with sleeping bags and hammocks—perfect for skipping the night without resetting your spawn point.

## 👁️ Quality of Life & Performance
We believe an immersive pack shouldn't break your computer. MineHaven is highly optimized to ensure smooth frame rates and clean interfaces.
* **Next-Gen Optimization:** Powered by *Sodium (Rubidium)*, *Iris Shaders*, *Lithium*, *ModernFix*, and *FerriteCore* for maximum FPS and seamless performance.
* **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map:** Keep track of your base, factories, and death locations with a clean, customizable radar and fullscreen map.
* **Immersive Visuals & Audio:** Features *Sound Physics Remastered* for realistic echoing caves, alongside *Spawn Animations*, *Chat Heads*, and *Better Third Person*.
* **Carry On:** Pick up chests and blocks with your bare hands.

---

> **MineHaven** is more than just a modpack; it's a server community waiting for your spark of creativity. Grab your wrench, pack your bags, and welcome home!
